// note: Thresholds come from real Lighthouse runs, not guesses. Accessibility and best-practices measured 100 on the live site and a local production build; they are the defensible numbers for a recruiter-facing page, so they gate CI everywhere.
// seo: SEO measures 92 on the scene-on URLs and 100 on ?scene=off — same markup, so the difference is Lighthouse's own robots.txt fetch timing out under the canvas's main-thread load rather than anything wrong with the file, which returns 200 and is valid. Kept at warn so a flaky fetch never breaks the build.
// performance: Asserted only on ?scene=off. A canvas that animates every frame never lets the main thread idle, so on the scene-on URLs TBT and TTI measure WebGL rather than this page and gating them would say nothing useful. ?scene=off renders the same page a phone actually receives — the scene is withheld there and offered instead — so it is the honest thing to hold a budget against. Measured 94 on CI (8 Sep 2026, mobile form factor, simulated throttling): FCP 0.9s, TBT 50ms, CLS 0.002, SI 1.2s all scoring 100, LCP 3.1s scoring 76 and carrying the whole deficit. Gate set at 0.90, four points below the measurement, which is room for run-to-run variance on a shared runner without letting a real regression through.
